name: exists_extend_basis_of_span_eq_top
summary: In the quotient V/span(y) the image of S spans; choose an independent family of images of length equal to the dimension of that span, lift it to z in S, and count dimensions.

steps.claim: In V/span(y), the image of S contains a linearly independent family w of length d = dim span(image of S).
steps.lean: choose w a _ j using exists_fun_fin_finrank_span_eq ℂ ((span ℂ (.range y)).mkQ '' S)

steps.claim: Lift each w_i to z_i ∈ S with z_i mod span(y) = w_i.
steps.lean: choose z hz e using a

steps.claim: Take k = d and z: every z_i lies in S, and y ⊕ z is linearly independent because y is independent and the images of z in the quotient by span(y) are independent.
steps.lean: exists _, z, hz, (linearIndependent_span i).sumElim_of_quotient z (funext e ▸ j :)

steps.claim: dim V = n + d: the span of the image of S is the image of span(S) = V, i.e. all of V/span(y); dim(V/span y) + dim span y = dim V and dim span y = n.
steps.lean:
rw [span_image, h, ← range_eq_map, range_mkQ, ← finrank_quotient_add_finrank,
    finrank_span_eq_card i]; simp; lia
